item.title: Minns vows to open 100 long-day childcare centres if re-elected
item.description: The Minns government will open 100 new long-day childcare centres in areas where there is high demand and an under-supply of childcare services. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: PearlBone gets FDA clearance for world's largest orthopaedic market
item.description: A bone graft substitute made from mother-of-pearl shells sourced off the WA's Kimberley coast receives FDA clearance in the United States. Academics say it is just one example of life-changing medical innovation from WA. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Jackson and Jess Baker

item.title: Do Australians actually want cheaper housing? We're finding out fast
item.description: Is the housing market about affordability or wealth? The battle between those desperate for house prices to drop and those wanting to protect their investments is coming to the fore as Australia's housing market takes a dramatic turn. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tom Crowley

item.title: Major police incident underway in Perth's south
item.description: Homicide detectives are investigating after a 44-year-old man was shot dead at a rural property in Perth's south this morning. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Albanese and Bowen caught discussing phones and 'dicks' in hot mic gaffe
item.description: The Prime Minister's office says Anthony Albanese and Chris Bowen were sharing a joke when a private conversation was inadvertently recorded at the COP31 summit. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Clare Armstrong

item.title: Stuart Bonds made ‘racist’ and ‘divisive’ comments. But One Nation is showing no sign of dumping the NSW candidate
item.description: The former coalminer’s claim Australians are being ‘demographically replaced’ sparked wide criticism, but his party has shown no signs of dumping him Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast In a Facebook video from a Sydney anti-immigration rally on Sunday, as a man dressed like a medieval knight watches on, One Nation’s lead upper house candidate, Stuart Bonds, launches into a speech against “mass” migration. “Make no mistake, we are being demographically replaced inside our own nation,” he says. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Penry Buckley

item.title: Microsoft ‘deeply sorry’ for global disruption that could have billion-dollar impact on Australia
item.description: Experts say outage exposes ‘Australia’s reliance on foreign technology’ as software giant says services being restored Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Microsoft outage could be a disaster for the Australian economy that forces some small businesses to close, with costs expected to run into the billions of dollars, experts have warned. The US software company has said it is “deeply sorry” for a widespread outage that caused disruption to millions of users, organisations and businesses across the globe – and that it has “addressed the underlying issue”. Continue… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Questions remain after Nvidia CEO's departure
item.description: While Jensen Huang's resignation puts an end to his long reign over Nvidia, questions about America's national security and Donald Trump's knowledge of the whole saga remain. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Annabel Bowles

item.title: Australia wins six Youth Olympics medals as African Games hailed
item.description: Australia has come away from the Youth Olympic Games in Senegal with six medals, as the IOC hails Africa's capability to host major multi--sport events. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Simon Smale

item.title: Regional bands say it's now cheaper to do a gig in London than interstate
item.description: Some of the country's hottest musical exports say it's now cheaper to fly to London or the United States for gigs than to travel interstate to play for Australian audiences. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joseph Hathaway-Wilson

item.title: Rope barriers at parliament round out prickly week for government
item.description: If the government wants to signal it's in touch with community concerns, walking through Hollywood-style velvet ropes and gold posts at parliament is probably not the best way to do it, writes Keane Bourke. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Keane Bourke

item.title: Litany of missed opportunities in Floreat murder tragedy
item.description: A coronial inquest into the deaths of Jennifer Petelczyc and daughter Gretl puts police errors under the microscope, and sees an apology from the gunman's daughter. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lucy Murray

item.title: Man dies after house fire in Geelong suburb
item.description: A man has died in a house fire in a suburb in outer Geelong that does not have a local fire station, despite one being promised by the Victorian government. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Larissa Ham and Harrison Tippet

item.title: Australian cricket urged to stop 'eating itself' as Sandpapergate rolls on
item.description: The ball-tampering scandal doesn't look like it's going away any time soon, with Greg Chappell fearing Australian cricket could "eat itself". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Fiji petrel eludes 10-day search as communities aim to protect bird's habitat
item.description: A new study details scientists' search for one of the planet's rarest birds in the waters off Fiji's Gau Island. Spanning 10 days, the expedition yielded no verified sightings of the critically endangered Fiji petrel, one of the world's most elusive birds. Fewer than 50 individuals are believed to remain on Earth. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Former NT administrator opens up about being groomed as a child
item.description: Former Northern Territory administrator Hugh Heggie was just 14 years old when an older church youth group leader began grooming him. He says he hopes sharing his story will help other survivors feel less alone. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Roxanne Fitzgerald

item.title: Police seeking witnesses after violent home invasion in Canberra
item.description: Three men armed with a firearm, knife, sword and baseball bat, broke into the home, allegedly assaulting a woman while a child was present. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Melbourne's 'liveable city' reputation questioned after fatal stabbing
item.description: The death of a Chinese delivery rider has fuelled debate on Chinese social media about whether Melbourne deserves its reputation as one of the world's most liveable cities. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Xiaoning Mo

item.title: Why these hand-picked blueberries could soon be harvested by robots
item.description: Western Australia's largest blueberry grower is investing in AI and autonomous machinery to help address labour shortages and costs as it ramps up its expansion plans. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joanna Prendergast and Chris Lewis
